title: Mounted Stantler keeps Sprint Walk speed and cardinal input

verification.actor: One prepared current Mounted Stantler (species 234, party slot 0), with the same live handle and attached presentation on map 33
verification.trigger: After checked location and party setup, hold Right for 160 completed game frames, release until the current motion ends, then hold Up and Right together for 40 frames
verification.observable: On a clear lane, normal mounted input accelerates from nominal Walk speed 8 to 4 and stays at 4. Each checked Walk travels one cardinal tile with at most two display frames of authored variance. No Hop starts. Two-direction input never starts a diagonal Walk or changes both player axes in one frame.

setupMutations.change: Use a disposable save, checked teleport to map 33 (585,402), prepared party slot 0 Stantler, native Mounted spawn and exact-subject bind. Do not write profile, speed, direction, chain state, RNG, Hop timing or input during observation.

limits: Prepared party and position do not prove natural capture, selection or spawning.
The Right run tests the real mounted Sprint resolver and Walk momentum. No action is forced and no timer is edited.
This is one clear-lane run and one two-direction input window, not every terrain or mounted species.

Copied-data controls must reject a missing Walk start, slow Walk, unexpected Hop, reset speed after acceleration, diagonal target and changed actor. The separate owner-reader control must remain accepted.

events.value: Place the player on the checked clear map 33 lane, prepare Stantler in party slot 0, then mount and bind that same live actor
Hold Right for 160 completed frames under the resolved Sprint profile; release until the current motion ends
Hold Up and Right together for 40 completed frames without changing movement policy

stop.condition: At least eight natural clear-lane Walks finish, nominal Walk speed reaches and stays at 4, no Hop starts, and the two-direction window remains cardinal-only

invariants: Each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result
No logical commit occurs after motion cancellation
Control returns after the selected motion finishes or cancels
No active actors share a nonzero target reservation
Every active actor handle uses the current field epoch
Every active actor has an attached presentation
